GQY Character and Brand Assets

Copyright (c) 2026 yxxbc. All rights reserved, except as permitted below.

The PolyForm Noncommercial License in LICENSE covers GQY's source code. It
does NOT cover the character and brand assets listed here. They are
governed by this file instead.

## What this covers

- The character 顾清影 / Selene: her name, look and character design.
- These files, and any later version of them:
    pics/gqy-logo.png
    pics/gqywallpaper.png
    pics/gqy-mascot-is-not-the-tui-version..png
    web/assets/gqy-logo.png
    web/assets/gqywallpaper.png
    assets/mascot/portrait.png
    assets/mascot/gqy-mascot-source.png

The images were created with AI image generation and then selected and
edited by the author. Rights are claimed to the extent the applicable law
allows. The naming and branding rules below apply whether or not a given
image is protected by copyright.

## You may

- Redistribute the assets unmodified as part of an unmodified copy of GQY.
- Run a privately modified copy of GQY for yourself with the assets in place.
- Show the assets in screenshots, reviews, tutorials and news coverage of GQY.
- Make noncommercial fan works of the character (art, memes, stories),
  as long as they are not presented as official.

## You may not

- Publicly distribute a modified version of GQY (a fork, a repackage, a
  hosted service) under the name 顾清影, Selene or GQY, or with these assets.
  A distributed fork must use its own name, logo and character.
- Use the assets or the character commercially.
- Imply that anything is made or endorsed by the GQY project when it is not.

## Earlier releases

Releases up to and including 0.6.0 shipped earlier versions of
pics/gqy-logo.png, pics/gqywallpaper.png and their web/assets copies under the
MIT License. Those exact copies, as shipped in those releases, remain
available under MIT. This file applies to every later version and to every
asset not included in those releases.

For other uses, open an issue at https://github.com/yxxbc/gqy-agent.

顾清影角色与品牌素材授权（中文说明，与上文英文版含义一致；如有出入以英文版为准）

LICENSE 中的 PolyForm Noncommercial 协议只覆盖源代码，不覆盖上面列出的角色与品牌
素材：顾清影 / Selene 的名字、形象与角色设定，以及列出的图片文件及其后续版本。
这些图片由 AI 生成后经作者挑选与修改，在法律允许的范围内主张权利；名字与品牌的
使用规则不论某张图是否受著作权保护都适用。

可以：随未修改的 GQY 原样分发；自己私下改代码运行时保留素材；在截图、评测、教程、
报道中展示；非商用的同人创作（不冒充官方）。

不可以：以「顾清影」「Selene」「GQY」的名义或带着这些素材公开发布修改版（fork、
二次打包、在线服务），公开发布的衍生版本必须换用自己的名字、logo 和角色；商用；
暗示未经认可的东西出自本项目。

0.6.0 及更早版本随附的旧版 logo 与壁纸按 MIT 发布，那几份原样副本仍可按 MIT 使用；
本文件适用于之后的所有版本和所有未包含在那些版本中的素材。其他用途请在
https://github.com/yxxbc/gqy-agent 提 issue 联系。
